scope: Evaluate only the supplied public snapshot, not external-world factual truth. Freeze before answer generation.
reviewer: Codex manual review against provided evidence and goals; no independent expert or LLM-as-judge calls

criteria.core_correct: All corpus-answerable requested core distinctions/components are accurate. Missing-country or fictional-recipe questions must explicitly identify missing evidence and not fabricate.
criteria.fully_answerable_completion: For 11 full-answer-available cases only, answer all requested core parts rather than abstaining on available knowledge.
criteria.grounded: All substantive factual claims are supported by supplied selected passages, including negatives; no inferred microbial details or new numerical data unless explicitly supported.
criteria.citation_valid: Every emitted citation ID belongs to the supplied evidence set; citation validity alone does not establish entailment.
criteria.missing_evidence_handled: Cases5/6/7 acknowledge UAE custom evidence absent; case13 rejects invented official recipe. All four must avoid fabrication.
